First, the waiver must include a signed no-default acknowledgment from Solterra — meaning Solterra must formally acknowledge in writing that, but for the waiver, the 1.14x DSCR would constitute a default under the loan agreement. Second, the waiver must include an express reservation of the bank's enforcement rights, so that granting this temporary waiver does not prejudice or waive the bank's ability to enforce remedies for this or any other breach going forward. Both elements must be present for the waiver to be legally effective. I should also note that this memo has not yet been attached to the committee packet, so I wanted to make sure everyone heard this directly before we proceed. With that, I'll turn it over to the next function for their input.
